sections.title: Tree and leaves
sections.text: This catalogue entry is Acer platanoides, the Norway maple. It is a deciduous tree that can reach 20–30 m. Opposite leaves have five sharply pointed lobes and are commonly 8–18 cm long.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: Yellow-green flowers appear in upright clusters before the leaves. The paired-winged samaras spread almost straight out and measure about 3–5.5 cm.
